name: Openclaude-App Development
description: Project board for tracking Openclaude-App development workflow
readme:
# 📋 Openclaude-App Project Board

## Board Columns

### 📥 Backlog
Tasks planned for future sprints.

### 📝 To Do
Tasks ready to be worked on.

### 🔄 In Progress
Currently active tasks.

### 👀 In Review
Tasks under code review (PR open).

### ✅ Done
Completed and merged tasks.

### 🚀 Released
Deployed to production.

## Labels

| Label | Color | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| `feature` | 🟢 Green | New features |
| `bug` | 🔴 Red | Bug reports |
| `hotfix` | 🟠 Orange | Emergency fixes |
| `refactor` | 🟡 Yellow | Code refactoring |
| `docs` | 🔵 Blue | Documentation |
| `ci/cd` | 🟣 Purple | CI/CD pipeline |
| `security` | ⚫ Black | Security issues |
| `priority: high` | 🔴 Red | High priority |
| `priority: medium` | 🟡 Yellow | Medium priority |
| `priority: low` | 🟢 Green | Low priority |

## Milestones

| Milestone | Due Date | Description |
|-----------|----------|-------------|
| v1.0.0 - MVP | - | Initial release |
| v1.1.0 - Features | - | Feature additions |
| v1.2.0 - Polish | - | UI/UX improvements |
| v2.0.0 - V2 | - | Major version update |

## Automation

- New issues → Backlog
- PR opened → In Review
- PR merged → Done
- Release created → Released

milestones.title: v2.0.0 - V2
milestones.description: Major version update with breaking changes

issues.title: Set up branch protection rules for main
issues.body:
Configure branch protection for main branch:
- 2 approvals required
- CI must pass
- No direct commits
- No force pushes

issues.title: Set up GitHub Environments (dev, staging, prod)
issues.body:
Create 3 GitHub environments:
- development (no protection)
- staging (1 approval)
- production (1 approval + 5min wait)

issues.title: Add signing keystore secrets
issues.body:
Add GitHub secrets:
- SIGNING_KEY
- ALIAS
- KEY_STORE_PASSWORD
- KEY_PASSWORD

issues.title: Implement user search functionality
issues.body: Add search bar to user list screen with real-time filtering.

issues.title: Add pull-to-refresh gesture
issues.body: Implement pull-to-refresh on user list to reload data from API.

issues.title: Implement offline caching with Room
issues.body: Cache API responses in Room database for offline access.

issues.title: Add dark mode support
issues.body: Implement dark theme with system-follow and manual toggle.

issues.title: Add unit tests for ViewModels
issues.body:
Write unit tests for:
- UserListViewModel
- UserDetailViewModel

issues.title: Add UI tests with Compose Testing
issues.body: Add instrumented UI tests for Compose screens.

issues.title: Implement error retry mechanism
issues.body: Add automatic retry with exponential backoff for failed API calls.

issues.title: Add app icon and splash screen
issues.body: Design and implement custom app icon and animated splash screen.

issues.title: Set up Firebase Analytics
issues.body: Integrate Firebase Analytics for user behavior tracking.

issues.title: Implement user creation form
issues.body: Add form to create new users with validation.

issues.title: Add dependency security scanning
issues.body: Configure dependency scanning in CI/CD pipeline.
